name: feature-flow
description: Capture ideas, plan feature bundles, harden implementation plans, and coordinate reviewed implementation delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and harden implementation work.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow provides separate Idea, Plan, Engineering Plan, and Implement skills. Idea records durable GitHub Ideas; Plan converges Feature Specs and implementation issues; Engineering Plan creates codebase-grounded plans or issue-hardening briefs without writing files; Implement coordinates isolated workers through reviewed PR-ready delivery while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea to capture this proposal as a durable Idea.
Use $plan to turn this Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle.
Use $feature-flow:engineering-plan to deepen an implementation plan or harden one issue.
Use $implement to coordinate delivery of a Feature Spec.
